compiled_state.title: As an epic-completion gate, I want a dogfood replay over seed PRs proving the evaluator surfaces findings the text reviewer missed, so the iteration loop value is empirically validated
compiled_state.author: Test

comments.body:
## Description

**What**: Build a dogfood replay harness that re-runs Integration A over a curated set of seed PRs and proves the visual-evaluator surfaces findings the text-mediated reviewer missed.

**Scope**:
- IN: Replay harness with documented seed-PR selection criteria
- IN: Missed-finding definition and comparison report output
- IN: Minimum-sample guard

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, replay harness runs seed PRs (last 90 days, ≥1 template/CSS/frontend file change) with Integration A enabled and produces a comparison report showing findings-new-to-visual-evaluator per PR
  <- Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, missed-finding defined as: severity≥medium finding in visual-evaluator output not present in prior reviewer-findings.json for that PR
  <- Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, on ≥3 seed PRs, evaluator surfaces ≥1 missed finding (calibration corpus seed-PR set as the reference)
  <- Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, if <3 qualifying PRs in the 90-day window, harness reports insufficient-sample rather than producing misleading results
  <- Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue. Escalate only when genuinely blocked. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
